desc: Derive the conflict characterization: a set is feasible iff no two intervals share the same left endpoint or the same right endpoint, and no two same-sign intervals cross; queries can be answered by earliest next conflict and suffix minima.

Implement the full Python solution: parse input into l[i], r[i] and plus/minus id lists; compute same-endpoint next conflicts by reverse scan over l and r; for each sign run the increasing-index sweep with two segment trees (min l over r-coordinates, max r over l-coordinates) and per-coordinate lazy heaps that only contain already-inserted intervals, extracting all previous same-sign crossing intervals and updating nxt; then build suffix minima and answer all queries.
Verify the implementation on samples and edge cases (single interval, adjacent intervals, same endpoints, same-sign crossing, opposite crossing) and fix any failures.
